tasks.prompt:
Research task (stay on official python.org sites: docs.python.org, peps.python.org, www.python.org, devguide.python.org). Find: (1) the Python version that introduced the `match` statement (structural pattern matching); (2) the number and authors of the PEP that is its *specification*; (3) the number and author of the separate *tutorial* PEP; (4) that Python version's first release date (x.y.0) and its end-of-life date as listed in the devguide 'Status of Python versions' table, plus its release-schedule PEP number. Do not read the full PEP texts; header fields are enough. Finish with exactly one line:
version=<x.y>; spec_pep=<n>; spec_authors=<names>; tutorial_pep=<n>; tutorial_author=<name>; first_release=<YYYY-MM-DD>; eol=<YYYY-MM-DD>; schedule_pep=<n>

success_criteria.notes: PEP 622 was superseded (Replaces: 622) — a model that stops at PEP 622 fails. devguide 3.10 row: end-of-life 2026-10-01.

tasks.hardness: 长链路 4 站 8 跳；需区分 spec/tutorial/被替代 PEP（622 陷阱）；devguide 表格读数
tasks.drift_policy: 全部为已发布历史事实（3.10 已 EOL），预期不漂移；devguide 若改 EOL 日期需复核

tasks.prompt:
Use English Wikipedia only. For each of the three 2001 Nobel Prize in Physics laureates (Eric Cornell, Wolfgang Ketterle, Carl Wieman), follow the 'Doctoral advisor' field in the infobox upward (advisor, then the advisor's advisor, ...) for at most 3 hops, and find the NEAREST ancestor who is himself/herself a Nobel laureate. If a person lists two advisors, check both. If the chain ends (no advisor listed / no article) before finding a laureate, answer NONE. Show the chain you followed for each, then finish with exactly one line:
cornell=<name> (<Nobel year>); ketterle=<name (year) or NONE>; wieman=<name> (<Nobel year>)

success_criteria.notes: Snapshot 2026-10-22: Cornell→David E. Pritchard→Daniel Kleppner→Norman Ramsey (Nobel 1989). Wieman→Theodor W. Hänsch (Nobel 2005). Ketterle→Herbert Walther (no advisor field) / Hartmut Figger (no article) → NONE. Hallucinating a laureate for Ketterle fails.

tasks.hardness: 多跳推理（最多 3 跳×3 人×双导师分支）；需诚实给出 NONE，测幻觉
tasks.drift_policy: Wikipedia 可被编辑：跑前用 scripts 中 API 复核 4 个 infobox（doctoral_advisor 字段）；不一致时以跑时页面为准并记录
tasks.gold_source: en.wikipedia.org API parse section=0 (Eric_Allin_Cornell, Wolfgang_Ketterle, Carl_Wieman, David_E._Pritchard, Daniel_Kleppner, Herbert_Walther)

tasks.prompt:

tasks.prompt:
我要在 2026 年底上线一个 Node.js 服务，要求它跑的 Node 主版本在 2027-12-31 之前一直有官方安全支持，而且上线时必须已经是 LTS（不接受 Current）。请以 nodejs.org 官方发布页 / nodejs/Release 仓库的 schedule 为准（可用 endoflife.date 交叉核对），回答：应该选哪个主版本？并说明为什么 Node 22 不行、Node 26 现在是否可选（看它进入 LTS 的日期与今天的关系）。最后一行严格输出：
choice=Node <n>; choice_eol=<YYYY-MM-DD>; node22_eol=<YYYY-MM-DD>; node26_lts_start=<YYYY-MM-DD>

success_criteria.notes: schedule.json: v22 end 2027-04-30; v24 lts 2025-10-28 end 2028-04-30; v26 lts 2026-10-28 end 2029-04-30. Before 2026-10-28 only Node 24 satisfies 'already LTS'; after that date Node 26 also passes. Rule accepts either pair so the task survives the date flip.

tasks.hardness: 带约束的模糊需求：需把『2027 年底』『已是 LTS』两个条件同时套上日期表；判断随时间翻转
tasks.drift_policy: EOL 日期固定；choice 在 2026-10-28 后可能从 24 变 26，rule 已两者都接受；2028 年后需重写

tasks.prompt:
Compare the current core specifications of HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3. Start from Wikipedia to find the RFC numbers, then verify each on the RFC Editor (rfc-editor.org) or IETF Datatracker page: publication month/year, which RFCs it obsoletes, its standards status, and the transport it runs on. Output a markdown table with columns: version, rfc, published, obsoletes, status, transport (one row per version). Then one line:
only_internet_standard=<version that is INTERNET STANDARD>; obsoletes_two=<version that obsoletes two RFCs>

success_criteria.notes: rfc-editor JSON: 9112 obsoletes RFC7230 (INTERNET STANDARD); 9113 obsoletes RFC7540+RFC8740 (PROPOSED STANDARD); 9114 obsoletes none (PROPOSED STANDARD), runs over QUIC (RFC 9000). Wikipedia may still cite 7540/7230 as older refs — must use current ones.

tasks.hardness: 跨 3 站（Wikipedia→rfc-editor/datatracker）；新旧 RFC 混淆陷阱；表格+结论
tasks.drift_policy: RFC 元数据只会因新 RFC 发布而变（obsoleted_by）；跑前用 rfc-editor JSON 复核
